home.subtitle: You are signed in to this establishment.

scopes.title: Scope manager
scopes.intro: The main account always keeps this page. A role is a list of scopes. An account can have a role and a few extra scopes.
scopes.deniedTitle: No access to the scope manager
scopes.deniedBody: The main account can grant the scope manager to another account, through a role or as an extra scope.
scopes.rolesIntro: Manage the roles for this organization.
scopes.builtIn: This built-in role cannot be changed.
scopes.locked: This account cannot lose the scope manager, account creation, or employee records.
scopes.passwordHint: Leave the password fields empty to keep the current password.

errors.invalid: Check the form and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only someone with the scope manager can do that.
errors.account_invalid: The account ID must start with a letter and use only letters, digits, and underscores.
errors.account_taken: That account ID is already used.
errors.password_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.role_invalid: Use a role name of 2 to 40 characters. The built-in roles cannot be reused.
errors.role_taken: That role name is already used.
errors.role_in_use: Move the accounts off this role before deleting it.
errors.owner_locked: The main account keeps the scope manager.
errors.not_found: That account or role is no longer here.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.deniedBody: The main account can grant account creation to another account, through a role or as an extra scope.

employees.title: Employees
employees.deniedBody: The main account can grant employee records to another account, through a role or as an extra scope.
employees.selfDeniedBody: This page is for an account of the establishment.
employees.exceptionHint: An exception replaces the usual week for that date.
employees.sharedEmpty: Nothing has been shared with you.

errors.invalid: Check the form and try again.
errors.not_found: That record is no longer here.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the account ID and password created when the account was issued. There is no public registration.

errors.invalid: Enter the account ID and password that were issued for this account.
errors.account_invalid: The account ID uses letters, digits, and underscores, and starts with a letter.
errors.credentials: Those credentials do not match an issued account.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is not available until the server is configured.

admin.title: Organizations
admin.subtitle: Each organization is one establishment. Create it here, with the account its administrator will use to sign in.
admin.deniedBody: This console is reserved for the platform host.
admin.unconfigured: The database is not configured yet. Add the Supabase values from .env.example, then sign in with the host account ID.
admin.created: Organization created. The administrator signs in with the account ID and password you just set.
admin.updated: Changes saved. The administrator signs in with the account ID shown here.
admin.passwordHint: Leave both password fields empty to keep the current password.

hints.slug: The administrator signs in on the main domain and is sent to this subdomain.
hints.account: The administrator connects with this account ID and password. The account is created now. There is no self-service registration.

errors.account_taken: That account ID is already used.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
